items.question: Is this free image stitcher online really free?
items.answer: Yes, our tool is 100% free to use. There are no hidden fees, subscriptions, or watermarks on your exported images.

items.question: How do I use this photo stitcher online?
items.answer: Simply set your canvas size, upload your images, and use your mouse to drag and arrange them. You can use the properties panel to rotate and adjust opacity for each layer.

items.question: Does my data stay private while merging photos online?
items.answer: Absolutely. This tool uses client-side processing, meaning your images never leave your computer or touch our servers.

items.question: What image formats are supported?
